description:
Heymondo helps you find the best travel insurance and get an instant quote, calculating your price effortlessly while you plan your next adventure.
- Travel insurance price: Get a quote and calculate the cost of your policy in seconds, directly within ChatGPT. 
- Global destinations: Coverage for Europe, UK, Mexico, Japan, Canada, India and more. 
- Plans tailored to your needs. 
- Direct booking: Get your quote right here in the chat, then click to access our website and finalize your international travel insurance.

Heymondo will process your personal data to enable the use of the app, provide its features, and handle inquiries related to travel insurance. Some features may rely on technology providers, including artificial intelligence services, which will process the information entered solely to provide the requested feature. You can exercise your rights at hello@heymondo.com and consult the full information in our Privacy Policy. Website: https://heymondo.com
